summary: Frontend-only test of BUG-643, BUG-642, CR-491 Wave 1 on preview URL (owner@palmhouse.com). BUG-643: SS3 X button, backdrop click and Esc all close SS3 while SS2 stays open; body pointer-events restored after all closed. BUT mouse-wheel scrolling inside SS3 is still blocked (wheel event defaultPrevented by Radix RemoveScroll of SS2) - only keyboard PageDown scrolls. BUG-642: Back button hidden on /dashboard, visible on /reports/audit, /credit, /settings, /menu, /day-closure; collapsed = icon only with title 'Go Back', expanded = 'Back' label; navigate(-1) works (settings->credit->dashboard). CR-491: demo routes (/settings-preview, /screen1-compare, /aggregator-preview, /printer-config-preview) render blank (auth + unauth); /aggregator/setup works; logos load locally (/mygenie-logo.svg on login, settings sidebar, restaurant-settings; /mygenie-logo.png in collapsed rail); Menu (MENU_ENDPOINTS v2/product/*), Day Closure settlement (v1/waiter/*), item-consumption/sales-audit reports load with 200s; API path diffs verified identical to previous inline strings. Login/logout and dashboard OK. Found pre-existing crash: /reports-module/profit-loss, /order-ledger, /item-sales throw 'ReferenceError: DATE_PRESETS is not defined' (not introduced by this change, but blocks P&L / REPORT_ENDPOINTS.PROFIT_LOSS verification).

ui_bugs.issue: Mouse wheel / trackpad scroll inside SS3 does not scroll (scrollTop stays 0; wheel event.defaultPrevented=true). RCA: SS2 Radix Sheet (modal) uses react-remove-scroll which cancels wheel/touchmove for any node outside SheetContent; SS3 is portaled to document.body so it is 'outside'. pointer-events wrapper fixed clicks but not scroll. Touch scroll on tablets likely blocked too. Keyboard PageDown works.

Pre-existing: page crashes with 'ReferenceError: DATE_PRESETS is not defined' (used at PLReportPage L234, OrderLedgerMockup L647, ItemSalesLedgerMockup L409 without import). App-level ErrorBoundary then stays in error state for every subsequent client-side route until full reload.

issues: Pages without Sidebar (/aggregator/setup, /restaurant-settings) have no Back button - PWA users still have no in-app back there (restaurant-settings has no sidebar at all).
/reports/audit shows both the page's own back arrow and the new sidebar back arrow side by side (duplicate controls).

action_items: BUG-643 scroll: make SS3 scrollable while SS2 open - e.g. set <Sheet modal={!billOrder}> or render OrderDetailSheet inside SheetContent (portal container = SheetContent node) so RemoveScroll treats it as inside; alternatively stop SS2 modal while SS3 open. Verify wheel + touch scroll.

Fix DATE_PRESETS missing import in PLReportPage.jsx, OrderLedgerMockup.jsx, ItemSalesLedgerMockup.jsx (import { DATE_PRESETS } from '@/utils/datePresets' - careful: these files define fmtISO locally) then re-verify P&L uses REPORT_ENDPOINTS.PROFIT_LOSS.
Optional: ErrorBoundary should reset on location change (key={location.pathname}) so one broken page does not brick all navigation.
Optional BUG-642: navigate(-1) has no fallback when there is no in-app history (PWA cold start on deep link) - fallback to navigate('/dashboard') when window.history.state?.idx === 0.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar Back: hidden-path check is inline string comparisons; fine, but no history fallback.
CR-491 endpoint constants: all migrated paths byte-identical to removed inline strings (verified via git diff).
All .bak files removed (0 remaining); demo page imports/routes removed; no remaining references in src.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (BUG-643 scroll fails; P&L page crash pre-existing)
